extracted.intended_audience: AHA members, hospital administrators, policy staff, and stakeholders tracking AHA regulatory and legislative comments
extracted.subtask_description: An organizational archive page listing recent AHA letters to federal regulatory agencies and legislators, summarizing the AHA's public comments and advocacy on proposed rules, reporting requirements, and legislation that affect hospitals and patient care.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose: comment on proposed and interim final rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Throughout the year, the AHA comments on a vast number of proposed and interim final rules put forth by the federal regulatory agencies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implicit guidance: AHA engagement in rulemaking is ongoing and encompasses both proposed and interim final rules, indicating submissions should be timely and targeted to active rulemaking dockets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose: communicate with federal legislators on legislative changes
rubrics_metrics.description: AHA communicates with federal legislators to convey the hospital field's position on potential legislative changes that would impact patients and patient care.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implicit guidance: Letters and communications should focus on how proposed legislation would affect hospitals, patients, and the delivery of patient care, providing the field's perspective and policy preferences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency: make letters public with subject and date
rubrics_metrics.description: The archive lists recent letters with titles, short descriptions, and dates (e.g., 'AHA Offers Support for Senate Medicare Advantage Improvement Act' — May 7, 2026).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implicit guidance: AHA publishes its correspondence publicly and organizes it by date and subject; letters intended for the archive should include a clear subject line, concise summary, and date to facilitate public access and tracking.
